q: Our buyer asks for Scope 2 both location based and market based. What is the difference?
title: Location based vs market based Scope 2
short: Location based uses the average grid factor where you are, 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh in India. Market based uses what you contracted: green tariffs, RECs or PPAs, with a residual mix factor for the rest. Report both; without contracts, the two figures are similar.

p: Total kWh times the national grid factor. Simple and always required.

ul: kWh covered by valid contracts or certificates at their own factor.
Remaining kWh at a residual mix factor if one is available, otherwise the grid factor, stated as such.

p: Keep REC retirement statements, green tariff bills or PPA invoices for the claimed kWh.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.
